purpose: Developer-only source activation catalog. A source is cataloged only after its fields, refresh contract, and professional purpose are documented. Cataloged does not mean live in a property report.

sources.label: Raw construction permit and certificate feed
sources.coverage: Statewide reported permits; DCA labels raw data unaudited and potentially incomplete.

sources.label: Development Trends Viewer / Construction Reporter
sources.coverage: County and municipality development, demolitions and construction measures.

sources.label: New Home Warranty Registry tables
sources.coverage: Reported enrollments and new-home price tables; excludes some construction types.

sources.label: Municipal Housing Profile Dashboard
sources.coverage: Housing conditions, costs, production, needs, evictions and households.

sources.label: Affordable Housing Dashboard / AHMS
sources.coverage: Municipal affordable-housing units and trust-fund information.

sources.label: Community Asset Map
sources.coverage: State mapped assets, amenities and special designations.

sources.label: Zoning Information Directory
sources.coverage: Links to municipal zoning maps, ordinances and contacts; municipality confirmation controls.

sources.label: PILOT Database Viewer and Financial Agreement Forecast
sources.coverage: Published municipal PILOT agreement and forecast context.

sources.label: Neighborhood Trends Database
sources.coverage: Published population, employment, housing, commute and cost context; never person-level profiling.

sources.label: Contaminated Site Remediation & Redevelopment GIS layers
sources.activation: live service family already connected; expanded marker contract ready
sources.coverage: Known Contaminated Sites, remediation information and related public mapping; screen only.
